rec.name: PDP Up-/Cross-Selling (Add-on Product Slider/Stack)
rec.status: Built — code delivered (Shopify theme block); setup guide still being simplified for non-developers

what.text: A compact up-/cross-sell module on the product page, placed directly under the Add-to-Cart area. It shows a merchant-curated list of related products (e.g. 'Buy it with', 'Pairs well with', 'You may also like'). Each row has a small product image, the product name (plus variant title if any), the price (with a struck-through compare-at price if one exists) and a compact '+ Add' button that adds that product to the cart without leaving the PDP. Three layouts are in the code: a 'Slides' carousel with prev/next arrows, a collapsible 'Stack' accordion, and a 'Normal' always-open list.

why.text: Shoppers who have already decided to buy are at their most receptive to a low-friction add-on. Showing a relevant, inexpensive complementary product right next to the main CTA, with a one-click add and no page change, raises AOV through impulse and complementarity ('goes well with'). The compact format avoids distracting from the main purchase, while a visible price keeps the decision easy.

how.text: 1) Create the snippet snippets/ed-cro-cross-selling.liquid and paste the delivered code. 2) Add a new block definition ('CRO | Up/Cross-Selling') to the product section schema (e.g. main-product.liquid). 3) Render the block in the product section/form so it appears under the buy buttons. 4) Create a product metafield (namespace/key standard.cro_up_cross_selling, type: list of products). 5) Add the block in the Theme Editor and configure heading, ATC text and layout. 6) Assign the add-on products to each product via the metafield. The Slides layout lazy-loads Swiper from a CDN; the Stack layout uses a custom collapsible with an open/closed toggle. The add button reuses the theme's product form and loader-button and inherits the primary button colors.

items: ATC button text (rich text, e.g. '+ Add')
Layout: Stack / Slides (the code also supports 'Normal')
Spacing top/bottom for desktop (>=1000px) and mobile (px)

Ticket wish list (not all visible in the final UI): heading font/color/bold/alignment, number of products, product spacing, hover zoom or alternate image, button shape (round to square), button color and alignment, links, optional 'Added' state, background color

dependencies.text: Product metafield 'CRO | Up/Cross-Selling' (namespace.key standard.cro_up_cross_selling, type list of products) must exist and be filled per product. Needs a theme with a product form using is='product-form' and is='loader-button' custom elements (Focal-like) and CSS variables --primary-button-background and --primary-button-text-color. Edits to the product section's schema and render logic are required (theme code editing). Swiper v11 is loaded from the jsDelivr CDN for the Slides layout. Reference themes in the ticket: Impact, Concept, Local.

items: Add-on attach rate (cross-sell ATC clicks / PDP sessions)
Main product ATC rate (check for no cannibalisation)

images.caption: Reference (Impact theme): 'You may also like' under Add to cart / Buy it now, with prev/next arrows, product image, name, price and a round '+ Add' button inside a bordered card
Reference (Concept theme): 'Pairs well with' header with outlined arrow buttons, a product image, name and price, and a dark pill '+ Add' button
Reference (Local theme): 'Goes well with' vertical list of products with square bordered images, divider lines and outlined 'Buy now' buttons
Concept mock-up: 'Passend dazu' module on a mobile PDP with image, name, rating, price, size selector and 'Hinzufügen' button
Final implementation on a PDP: 'Buy it with' module (red box) directly under the Add-to-cart button, with small arrows, bordered row, image, name with variant, price and '+ Add' button
Theme editor settings: required metafield note, Enable toggle, Heading, ATC Text and Layout (Stack/Slides)
